name: Illini Cubers Winter 2026
information: Join the Illini Cubers Registered Student Organization at the University of Illinois where we will hold three official rounds of 3x3x3 during a weekly meeting. Any minors **must** be accomanpied by a guardian while in the venue. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![MCA Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcW95IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--168d2d20fa1ad18ff231abc78aaace869d52ca1a/image.png)
